description: Lists boards (clusters in the app) with links. One level by default: a workspace's boards, or with parent the boards inside one, paged by has_more and next_offset. depth reads the hierarchy in one answer; deleted true lists boards restore_board can bring back.

deleted.description: Deleted boards that can be restored

depth.description: Levels at once, max 20 (at most 500 boards)

draft.description: The draft key create_boards returned. Pass it on every call about that draft.

parent.description: A board id, or "root" for the top level

response_format.description: Default concise; detailed adds how each board opens and its dates

workspace_id.description: Only this workspace; with depth, the one to map

name: list_boards
title: List boards
